title: Support 2D sizes and height descriptors in srcset
body: This allows responsive image selection to account for both dimensions and object fitting (`contain` / `cover`), fixing source selection when an image is constrained by height or `object-fit`. - Re-introduces the `` (`h`) alongside `` (`w`) in `srcset` image candidate strings so each candidate's aspect ratio can be determined before fetching. - Extends `` to accept `[ contain | cover ] `, representing a fit mode, width, and height. Bare 2D `` items without a `` are permitted before the final item in a `` without a parse error so authors can provide a 1D fallback for legacy user agents (e.g., `sizes="cover 400px 400px, 400px"`). - Instead of using the `concrete object size` width (which depends on the already-loaded image's natural aspect ratio or causes inconsistent selection with `object-fit: cover` / `contain`), `sizes="auto"` now resolves to a `source size` struct using the `img` element's `content box` width and height and its computed `'object-fit'` value (`'contain'`/`'scale-down'` -> `"contain"`, `'cover'` -> `"cover"`, `'fill'`/`'none'` -> `"fill"`). - Computes each candidate's aspect ratio from its `w` and `h` descriptors (falling back to the `dimension attribute aspect ratio` from `width`/`height` attributes on the element, derives the candidate's `source concrete width` given the `source size`'s `width`, `height`, and `fit`, and normalizes the candidate's pixel density using that concrete width prior to `select an image source from a source set` (covering ``, ``, ``, and `Link:` HTTP preload headers). - Tracks `width` and `height` attribute mutations on `` and preceding `` elements in ``, and for `sizes="auto"`, reacts to changes in the `img`'s `content box` width or height or computed `'object-fit'` property. Fixes #12248.
